themes.title: Electoral Volatility and Internal Friction Facing Right-Wing Parties
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across Europe and North America are contending with internal strategic disputes, voter erosion after taking governance responsibility, and mid-term campaigning friction. From Swedish populist support dips to local coalition squabbles in Italy and donor tension in the US, right-leaning movements are navigating shifting voter expectations.
